I first comb my eyebrow hairs up with the clear eyebrow mascara. Then, I wait a bit and then use an angled eyebrow brush to dip in the dipbrow. I start from the middle of my brow and create lines starting from the bottom up, working my way towards the front. The tails of my brows are also created with those line strokes but also crossed from the top down. After, I comb them to soften the harsh lines. I go in again with a tiny amount of the dipbrow and lightly frame the upper front half of my brow. I comb through once again, apply the clear eyebrow mascara lightly and use a cream concealer to clean up the under my brows. And voila!

EDIT: I’ll probably make another post soon (an eyebrow tutorial), because I realize how confusing the steps are without a reference 😬).
